regime_context: Hong Kong thematic leadership is narrow (4 of 17 eligible) and concentrated in Energy (top, trend, durable, uncrowded) with Banks as a crowded runner-up. The absolute-trend gate has validated risk-control value on this market's history, so trend eligibility is meaningful; but nearly all themes lack proxy ETFs (only two Tech themes are scorable) and the two scorable names (China Tech, Platform Tech) are firmly ineligible/negative, leaving little cleanly gradeable surface.
emerging_watch: Watching whether China Tech & Internet (3033.HK) breaks back above its own recent high and crosses the eligibility gate — a confirmed handoff would signal that the current narrow Energy-led tape is broadening and the momentum leadership is rotating, retiring the current underweight read on that theme.

theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Energy is the narrow leader with the strongest momentum score, a trend hurst tag, the highest durability bar (0.76), high breadth (0.8), and uncrowded positioning — the trend-gate and durability legs support staying power even though the rank itself is not a return forecast. This is a direction on the theme, not a size.
evidence: rank=1 with score 1.518 and eligible=true (trend gate)
theses.dissent: Scorable=false, so the lean is hard to grade against a clean proxy; and a narrow 0.24 eligible fraction means the whole tape is risk-off — the leader can fall just as fast if the Hang Seng broad complex rolls over.
